item.title: Takeout Photo 0.1.0
item.description:
Takeout Photo 0.1.0
First release of Takeout Photo for Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 12 or later).
- Reads your Google Photos Takeout on your own Mac: photo timeline with trips, homes and places, maps and routes, on-device AI curation, Strava matching and Proton Photos sync. - Free to download and explore with the sample library; sign in with Google or Apple and buy a plan to import your own Takeout (Lifetime, or Yearly with automatic processing). One account covers 2 Macs. - Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple; updates itself (Check for Updates…).
